task.description: Owner, 2026-10-18 (after rn-showcase ran on an iPad Pro): a real platform layer that reports the kind of device and its details, on iOS and Android first, then every other platform. Today Platform.isPad and Platform.isTV are false constants (lib/std/react-native.tsx) and zinc:sys device('device') is uname's machine and release (src/host/sys_host.cpp). Model on expo-device (deviceType PHONE/TABLET/DESKTOP/TV/UNKNOWN, brand, manufacturer, modelName, modelId, designName, osName, osVersion, osBuildId, totalMemory, supportedCpuArchitectures, isDevice, deviceYearClass) and React Native's Platform (isPad, isTV, Platform.constants: interfaceIdiom, systemName, Brand, Manufacturer, Model, Release). Sources: iOS UIDevice (userInterfaceIdiom, systemName, systemVersion), sysctl hw.machine (iPad6,7) mapped to a marketing name by a table; Android Build.* (MANUFACTURER, BRAND, MODEL, DEVICE, ID) and the smallest screen width / UI_MODE_TYPE_TELEVISION for tablet and TV; macOS sysctl hw.model and IOKit's product name; Linux /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/model (Raspberry Pi), /sys/class/dmi/id/product_name; web navigator.userAgentData. ZINC_PLATFORM=ios|android on the desktop answers a simulated phone.

acceptanceCriteria.text: One query (zinc:sys device('device'), JSON) answers type, brand, manufacturer, modelName, modelId, osName, osVersion, osBuildId, totalMemory, cpuArchitectures, isDevice on macOS, iOS, Android and Linux; fields a platform cannot know are empty, never invented
A std module zinc:device exposes them as expo-device does (DeviceType enum, getDeviceTypeAsync is a plain function), documented in docs/react-native.md and a guide page
Platform.isPad, Platform.isTV and Platform.constants come from it; Platform.isPad is true on an iPad and false on an iPhone
Tablet versus phone on Android follows the smallest screen width (600 dp), TV follows UI_MODE_TYPE_TELEVISION
A T0 test checks the JSON on the development Mac and with ZINC_PLATFORM=ios|android; iOS (simulator) and Android (emulator) proven by an app that prints the record

task.title: Device information: device type, model, maker and system details on every platform
